description: Steer a rigid 3D hologram through three projection dies that advance only on deliberate control steps.
name: Hologram Silhouette Foundry V2 · Difficulty 4 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Steer one rigid colored rod assembly until every colored tip center lies inside its matching ring in FRONT, SIDE and TOP. Start with IGNITE FOUNDRY; after ignition, each accepted gantry control advances the dies by one fixed 20 ms step and waiting leaves the current pose and rings unchanged. Simultaneous fit builds fusion; lost fit drains it. Build full fusion, then CERTIFY CASTING. An early submission or 4,500 unfused control steps ends the episode. Preparation is safe; there is no in-game stop, reset or retry. Drag the round gantry handles; the small cyan ticks show the current physical gantry. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any other implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to pre-existing, unrelated, blank or browser-settings tabs. Tabs opened by a visible task control are allowed only when part of this task, using their visible controls.
